name: Rabbi Dovid Kestenbaum
title: Founder & Educational Director
bio: For a long time, Rabbi Dovid Kestenbaum has had a vision of providing students across the world the tools to be the best learners they can be. Throughout over 30 years of being a rebbe and a principal, this approach has driven him in his teaching methodology and his interactions with his thousands of students along the way. Rabbi Kestenbaum founded Lomdei with the intention of providing this style of learning to as many students as possible. He has taken his vision and created a platform that has reached thousands of students across the United States, Canada and Europe. He leads Lomdei as its Educational Director towards its ultimate goal - להגדיל תורה ולהאדירה

name: Mr. Raphael Alter
title: Managing Partner, Director of Operations and Business Development

name: Rabbi Jeremy Hartstein
title: Director of Learning Platform Division
bio: Rabbi Hartstein serves as Lomdei’s Director of Teacher Development. Joining the Lomdei team over a year ago, he has been building and cultivating relationships with teachers all over the world who are using Lomdei to enrich their classrooms each day. He manages teacher training and development and meets with teachers and administrators regularly throughout the school year. He also heads Lomdei's Teacher Community, facilitating best practices teacher building workshops, connecting Lomdei teachers around the world. His other responsibilities include tech-support and working with our development team to constantly improve the Lomdei experience.

name: Rabbi Peretz Hochbaum
title: Lomdei Regional Director NY/NJ; Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Rabbi Peretz Hochbaum is a master educator, inspiring visionary leader and an effective team builder. He is experienced on all levels, K-12, and has served in leadership roles at prominent institutions including Rambam Mesivta, HANC, Mesivta Tiferes Yisroel and Camp Kaylie. He is also the Founder and Director of BPE Educational Services, an Educational Consulting firm. For more than 30 years, Rabbi Hochbaum has supervised and led all aspects of school including both Religious and General Studies programs, curriculum development and student services. He has implemented staff In-Service Training & evaluation, and has presented extensively on a wide range of educational topics including methodology & didactics, class management, differentiation, cooperative learning and curriculum pacing/mapping. In coming on board at Lomdei Rabbi Hochbaum summed up his feelings as follows: “I am so fortunate to have a successful career in chinuch, and I am humbled to, with Hashem’s help, have made an impact on my students, faculty, and community through my efforts. I am truly excited to be joining Lomdei’s wonderful team of educational thinkers and leaders who are working diligently to challenge the status quo and change the future landscape of Jewish education.”

name: Mrs. Chani Richmond
title: Director of PD & Coaching Division
bio: Chani Richmond is a Judaic Studies Education Leader and Curriculum Developer, with over 20 years of education and special education experience. She has left her mark of excellence in Jewish education and leadership on schools in both New York and Florida. She currently holds the position of Hybrid Learning Coordinator at Yeshiva Toras Chaim Toras Emes, Klurman Elementary School in North Miami Beach, Florida. She is a past member of the JTS Tanakh Standards and Benchmarks Project, and the 'JBlend Miami' Blended & Personalized Learning Initiative. She brings years of experience in curriculum development and the know-how of personalization in the creation of a blended learning environment in the Judaic Studies classroom. Her additional roles include being a former Sefaria Partner Educator, Torah Live Ambassador, and Prizmah/JEIC Edtech Facilitator & Coach. She is the owner and founder of CR Education Advisors, LLC (https://www.linkedin.com/in/chani-richmond-01738330/).

name: Mrs. Lauren Adler
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Lauren Adler served as the Coordinator and Coach of Instructional Technology at the Moriah School in Englewood, NJ. She worked closely with educators and administrators to further the school's mission of personalizing learning for each student. Lauren met regularly with teachers to assist them in examining their student achievement data which informed their curricular decisions. Lauren also assumed the role of technology integration coach where she modeled and supported the integration of technology and personalized learning tools in classrooms throughout the school. Prior to this role she was a 4th grade classroom teacher for 15 years. Lauren has been a Lomdei coach for 2 years and has supported many teachers to adapt a blended/personalized learning approach in their classroom.

name: Mrs. Lakie Blech
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Lakie never planned on going into education. She initially chose fitness instructing as her “official job,” becoming a household name in the fitness industry with her DVDs, classes, and Bat Mitzvah motivating. Upon moving to Maryland, she pivoted to a role as a tutor at a local Montessori school. The school soon trained her to be a teacher, and she quickly revamped the curriculum and teaching methods. In Phoenix, AZ, Lakie taught grades two and four, covering both Judaic and General studies. She became an integral part of the school, sought after as a peer and mentor for her innovative ideas. She also modernized the school's technology and marketing capabilities, streamlining communications, programs, methods, systems, and reputation. Lakie calls herself a transformer. She holds an MEd, a Principalship in Education and Innovation from ASU, a Nitivot Montessori training Certificate, a Bachelor's in Humanities with a focus on Education, and other credentials.

name: Mrs. Esther Landau
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Esther Landau is a detail-oriented professional with a strong educational background and extensive experience in education and coaching. She holds a Masters of Education in Special Education from Grand Canyon University and is trained as a Dyslexia reading specialist through Orton Gillingham, as well as a Kriah specialist. Esther's career includes experience as a Classroom Teacher and Reading Specialist at the Hebrew Academy of Cleveland. She has received training from Lomdei in Blended and Personalized Learning as well as Project Based Learning. She currently enjoys living in Israel.

name: Mrs. Shulamit Lichtenstein
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Shulamit has taught in elementary schools for over 15 years. She started by teaching in Wolfson Hillel Primary School in London, UK for ten years, with leadership responsibility for Years 5 and 6 in the last 3 years. On making aliya, she taught in a few dati leumi schools in Jerusalem, including in an experimental English immersion project. She currently resides in Toronto.

name: Mrs. Rochel Markis
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Rochel Markis has been an educator for over ten years. Before recently making aliyah, Rochel was teaching high school English at Fort Hamilton High School in Brooklyn, New York, and she is certified to teach adolescent English grades 7-12 through CUNY's Hunter College education program. Rochel also has a master's degree in English literature and composition from CUNY's Queens College. Since moving to Israel, Rochel has been teaching English at URJ Heller High School, and she was also a teaching fellow at TALMA’s Israel Program for Excellence in English for the 2022-2023 school year.

name: Mrs. Malkie Merrill
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: I have been a teacher for over 20 years in various subjects and grades. After making Aliyah 3 years ago, I began coaching new teachers in instruction, methodology, lesson planning and classroom management.

name: Rabbi Shimon Newman
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Rabbi Shimon Newman has been an inspirational educator for over 25 years. He taught a fourth grade class at Eitz Chaim Schools, in Toronto, for many years, serving both as the rebbe and general studies teacher. Shimon was also the Head Principal of the two girl branches of Eitz Chaim. In addition, he has taught in the NYC public school system and children with developmental delays. Shimon has also taught grades 4-8, has experience with early childhood education and most recently has taught Jewish History to high school students. Shimon holds a BA in psychology, a masters in special education and masters in school administration.

name: Rabbi Dr. Avichai Pepper
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Rabbi Dr. Avichai Pepper is a graduate of the New England Rabbinical College in Providence, RI. He holds a Master’s degree in Educational Leadership from Bellevue University, Master’s degree in Counseling from Liberty University, and a Doctorate in Educational Leadership from Liberty University. He brings experience for more than a quarter of a decade of work in the field of education. He currently serves as the Director of Educational Support Services, focused on student development, growth, empowerment, and a positive school culture and atmosphere.

name: Mrs. Tzippy Richmond
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Tzippy Richmond has been an educator for over 20 years. She started her career as a Morah in YCQ and special educator in HALB and YESS. She was the principal at Hebrew Academy of Palm Beach, as well as Masoret Yehudit. She currently teaches students with autism in Palm Beach County Public schools, and works for COJDS as their Florida liaison. In addition, she is the director of Yahalom Florida, a resource center for special needs children and their families.

name: Rabbi Moshe Stavsky
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Rabbi Moshe Stavsky has taught high school limudei kodesh for the past thirteen years. Prior to making Aliya in 2022, he coached numerous teachers while working at the Ramaz Upper School, both as teacher mentor and as chair of the Tanach department. He currently also serves as a content creator for Lomdei’s Learning Platform. Rabbi Stavsky received semicha from RIETS, holds an MA in Tanach from Revel and learned in the Katz Kollel and Wexner kollel elyon at RIETS.

name: Mrs. Elana Soroka
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Elana is a creative educator who thinks outside the box, constantly evaluating what would be the most dynamic way for her students to interact with the material and relate it to their lives. Elana has had many varied experiences in formal and informal Jewish education. She has supported and mentored teachers as a Special Education Coordinator, as well as taught Classroom Management and Organization in Talpiyot College for Women. She currently teaches Middle School Judaic Studies at Netivot Hatorah Day School in Toronto.

name: Rabbi Shmuli Soroka
title: Instructional Coach; PD and Coaching Division
bio: Rabbi Shmuli Soroka is a passionate educator, who began his education career at NCSY, where he had to first recruit his students into the classroom, and then make the learning vibrant enough to entice the students to stay. He has since taught Middle School Judaic Studies at Netivot HaTorah Day School where he currently is the Director of Jewish Life and Learning. Rabbi Soroka has also taught Tefillah, Parsha and tutored students at Kayla's Children's Centre. He has a Masters in Education from Azreili, and received Smicha from Rabbi Eliezer Breitowitz and Rabbi Reuven Silver.
